system.description:
When an attack would leave you dead or at Death's Door, you may roll a CR 1 Heart Check. On a success, if your companion is within 25 ft, it takes all of that Strike's damage instead of you.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.54
system.summary: When an attack would leave you dead or at Death's Door, you may roll a CR 1 Heart Check. On a success, if your companion is within 25 ft, it takes all of that Strike's damage instead of you.

automation.onSuccess: If your companion is within 25 ft, it takes all of the Strike's damage instead of you.
automation.onFail: You take the damage as normal.

automation.note: Roll before the damage is applied. On a success with your companion within 25 ft, apply the whole Strike's damage to the companion instead of you.
